name: team-dependency
description: Another team's deliverable (analytics pipeline) delayed. Blocking mobile payment implementation. Need collaborative approach.
expected_behavior: Present options: negotiate interim version, mock data, parallel work, escalate. Maintain inter-team collaboration.
scenarios: Another team controls the blocking deliverable
Timeline slip already occurred (2 weeks → 3 weeks)
success_indicators: Blocker is stated (analytics pipeline, 3-week ETA, was 2 weeks)
Timeline impact highlighted (ship date at risk)
Options include: negotiate interim, mock, parallel, escalate
Integration costs mentioned (1 day to swap real data)
Collaborative tone (don't blame the other team)
Escalation path is collaborative (talk to tech lead first)
